video.huTitle: Magyar népmesék: A mezeinyúl és a sündisznó

summary.hu: A nyúl nagyon büszke: ő a leggyorsabb!
summary.en: The hare is very proud: he's the fastest!
summary.ro: Iepurele e foarte mândru: e cel mai rapid!

summary.hu: Kineveti a sündisznót a rövid lábai miatt.
summary.en: He laughs at the hedgehog because of his short legs.
summary.ro: Râde de arici din cauza picioarelor lui scurte.

summary.hu: A sün felesége a pálya végére áll, és ugyanúgy néz ki, mint a férje.
summary.en: The hedgehog's wife stands at the end of the track, and she looks just like her husband.
summary.ro: Soția ariciului stă la capătul pistei și arată exact ca soțul ei.

summary.hu: A nyúl fut, fut, de a végén mindig ott a sün: „Én már itt vagyok!”
summary.en: The hare runs and runs, but at the end the hedgehog is always there: "I'm already here!"
summary.ro: Iepurele aleargă și aleargă, dar la capăt ariciul e mereu acolo: „Eu sunt deja aici!”

questions.qEn: Who stands at the end of the track?

questions.q: Mit mond a sün a végén?
questions.qEn: What does the hedgehog say at the end?
